message: I always thought I was just slightly more organized than most, but it turns out I might be the gloriously over-prepared person in my friend group. The other day, I pulled out my go-bag to check supplies and found enough snacks to last through a weekend camping trip—just in case! 😅 While it might seem excessive, I find comfort in knowing I'm ready for anything life throws my way. Do you have a preparedness tip or trick that keeps you feeling ready without going overboard?
